newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends lower after choppy session.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends lower after choppy session.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Profit-taking and selling emerged in late trading and prices closed lower. The market opened firmer on Egyptian's tender, soyoil gains in Chicago and tightness in the near-term. Prices seen consolidating until release of PORLA data at the end of the week.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also fell with some refiners covering seen. Interest seen in nearby CPO and RBD palm olein.

"Fundamentally, the market looks friendly and falls were marginal," a trader said, adding that news of plantations houses forecast falls of up to 12 percent in January production having little impact on the market.

Output in the near-term would be lower because of the seasonal downtrend and the twin festivals of Chinese New Year and Moslem Eid al-Fitr holidays which had limited harvesting. Some traders forecast that February's production would drop by up to 20 percent.

Activity was confined mainly to spread trading from April/May and May/July and short-covering, traders said, adding that players were unwilling to take up fresh positions ahead of the release of official January crop data this weekend.
Profit-taking and light selling emerged in late trading pushing prices to the minus territory.
Third month futures, May futures closed five ringgit lower at 1,299 ringgit ($522.21) a tonne after trading in a 14-ringgit range.
Small falls were seen in other positions.

Physicals Feb (south) crude palm oil was offered 1,360 ringgit a tonne against bids of 1,357.50 with earlier trades at 1,365 and 1,360. Feb (central) saw offers at 1,360 and bids at 1,350 and Feb (north) at 1,350 against 1,340.
Mar (south) was offered at 1,360 with bids at 1,350 after trading at 1,360. Mar (central) saw offers at 1,350 with bids at 1,340.
Among refined products, Mar RBD palm oil was offered at $570 a tonne FOB Malaysia, Apr at $562.50 and Apr/May/Jun at $557.50. Mar was traded at $568.
Mar RBD palm olein saw offers at $595, Apr at $590 and Apr/May/Jun at $582.50. Mar was traded at $595, $593 and $592.50, and Apr/May/Jun at $582.50 and $581.
Mar/Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $465 and Mar palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $310.
